overlayEntry.notes: infiniFi is an onchain fractional-reserve USDC credit protocol: iUSD is the USDC receipt token (1:1 mint/redeem, no fee), siUSD the staked liquid tranche, liUSD-xw locked position tokens across 1-13 week buckets, with assets duration-matched to liability buckets. This replaces the 2026-07-20 entry with a refreshed portfolio measurement; all grade rationales from that review were re-checked against the current docs and stand. Portfolio per the protocol's real-time API (fetched 2026-07-27T23:09:49Z): $61.07M total across Fasanara mGLOBAL GDADF short-dated receivables fund ($31.01M, 4w bucket, matures 2026-08-24), STRCx Strategy-preferred credit router ($10.28M, 4w, matures 2026-07-31), New Silver junior residential-investment-loan position ($5.09M, 8w, matures 2026-09-21), Spark sUSDC ($3.09M, liquid), liquid-cap reserve ($3.05M, liquid), Fasanara RWA farm ($2.58M, 4w, matures 2026-08-24), Aave v4 USDG lending ($2.25M, 1w), FalconX farm ($2.00M, 1w), Morpho Steakhouse infiniFi vault ($1.13M, 1w), Sentora PRIME (Figure HELOC-backed, $0.59M, 1w), dust elsewhere; the API also reports zero pending redemptions, $6.15M liquid assets, iUSD supply 61.07M with 40.98M staked and 19.73M locked. weightedAverageMaturityDays derivation: asset-weighted days-to-maturity from the API's per-farm maturityTimestampMs, anchored at the 2026-07-27T23:09:49Z fetch, liquid farms counted as 0 days: (31,006,179.42x28 + 10,281,475.05x4 + 5,091,234.82x56 + 2,576,818.75x28 + 2,251,935.67x7 + 2,001,760.35x7 + 1,129,978.65x7 + 586,561.61x7 + 14.61x7) / 61,073,863.63 = 1,308,350,755 / 61,073,863.63 = 21.422433 days; the published farm bucket labels (1w/4w/8w) corroborate the maturity timestamps. valuationCadenceDays = 1, unchanged: NAV is maintained by the onchain Accounting contract with yield distributed over 8-hour epochs, and the published vault page is regenerated daily from the protocol API, so valuation is at worst daily and effectively continuous onchain. Seniority and recovery: documented two-tranche waterfall in which liUSD absorbs any confirmed impairment pro-rata via an atomic onchain redemption-rate reduction (permanent, with a $25k safety buffer and post-mortem disclosure commitment; recovery proceeds are to be airdropped to slashed holders), while siUSD/iUSD seniors are impaired only after the junior tranche is exhausted, via a pro-rata negative rebase; AMM pools (Curve/Balancer/Fluid) act as a market exit path when the redemption queue is illiquid. Components are unchanged: creditQuality, seniority, valuationCadence, maturityAndLiquidity, and recovery adequate; custody limited. legalEnforceability remains omitted (bounded): the 2026-07-20 review found that docs reference 'infiniFi Labs' and Master Borrower Agreements but publish neither entity details nor the agreements; the 2026-07-27 re-check found no new legal-structure disclosure anywhere in the docs index or main site, and while a Terms page exists at app.infinifi.xyz/terms it sits behind a Cloudflare interactive challenge and could not be pinned, so it is inadmissible under the D3 standard; per that standard, absence of evidence keeps the component bounded rather than weak. Standing caveats carried forward: (1) the offchain credit legs' custody, segregation, and bankruptcy-remoteness terms (Fasanara funds, FalconX, New Silver) are not disclosed, so custody is limited rather than adequate; (2) no independent fund administrator exists - valuation is protocol-self-administered onchain (publicly verifiable, but not independent); (3) concentration risk: Fasanara GDADF alone is ~51% of assets and STRCx ~17% single-issuer credit, and the New Silver position is a junior tranche.
